subject: Re: BrightWave evaluation — credit + short extension to close?
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha@brightwave.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-26T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — 30d extension + evaluation credit to close

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Jordan and I ran a short integration pass and we can get the internal stakeholders across the finish line if we can buy another 30 days of evaluation and a small usage credit to stress-test the full ingestion pipeline. Specifically: 30-day extension on the trial + an upfront $8k usage buffer (we'll only charge what we use).

Our headcount approval for a pilot is locked behind two bench tests that will run in that window. If we can get the extension + credit, I can commit to a buying timetable (legal/PO) by mid-July. Is that something Redwood can provide for a mid-market pilot?

Appreciate any quick signal — we're in EOW review and want to include Redwood in the short list.

Best,
Sasha Patel
Director of ML Systems
BrightWave Analytics
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@brightwave.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-26T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 30d extension + evaluation credit to close

Hi Sasha — great to hear and thanks for the clear ask.

Short answer: yes, we can help close this. Proposed structure to unblock you quickly:
- 30-day extension to your current eval window.
- One-time usage credit of up to $6,000 (applies to generation/embedding tokens only).
- Condition: sign an annual contract (12 months) at standard mid-market terms by 2026-07-10.
- Credit delivery: applied as a pre-paid trial credit on your account; any unused portion expires at the end of the 30-day extension.

If that works for you we can get this approved internally today and I will send the credit terms + signature-ready MOP for your legal team. Im cc'ing Karthik for quick manager approval.

Next steps: Confirm you accept the above structure and I'll route for ops/finance.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri ya@redwood.ai
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Patel <sasha@brightwave.ai>, Jordan Hughes <j.hughes@brightwave.ai>
Date: 2026-06-27T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightWave — request for 30d + usage credit (need approval)

Karthik / Laura — forwarding the ask from BrightWave (summary below). Would like to get a quick playbook approval so we can commit and not lose momentum.

Deal summary:
- Account: BrightWave Analytics (mid-market ML analytics)
- ARR intent: 12-month pilot -> expected expansion to enterprise plan if pilot succeeds
- Ask: 30-day extension + $6k usage credit (proposed by me as a balanced figure)
- Timeline: customer can provide PO/signature by 2026-07-10 if incentive approved

Why now: customer is in final vendor shortlist and needs a short-run stress test to sign. This is an end-of-quarter acceleration opportunity.

Requested approvals:
1) Sales Ops (Laura) to confirm contract/credit wording and MOP template.
2) Finance (Marcus) to clear $6k promo credit cap and delivery method.

Attachments: none yet — will attach credit terms once Sales Ops provides standard template.

Thanks for a quick look — can we get an OK today?

Priya
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Patel <sasha@brightwave.ai>
Date: 2026-06-27T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: BrightWave — request for 30d + usage credit (need approval)

Thanks Priya — FYI attaching the standard credit terms and our MOP template. Two quick operational notes:
- We prefer to issue trial credits as account-level promo credits (applied immediately) rather than post-bill rebates for simplicity.
- For credits > $5k we need finance sign-off and legal counterparty review.

Proposed tweak: If finance pushes back we can split as $3k account credit now + $3k SKU-level rebate on production usage within 90 days after signed contract. That structure has closed before.

See attached: brightwave_credit_terms_v1.pdf, signed_mop_template.docx

Laura Bennett
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-29T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BrightWave — request for 30d + usage credit (finance input)

Quick finance take after reviewing the playbook and expected ARR:
- Approve a maximum of $5,000 total credit for this deal (we will honor up to $5k applied as account credit).
- Approval conditional on: signed 12-month agreement executed by 2026-07-10 OR a PO demonstrating intent to commit to 12 months with billing terms agreed.
- If customer needs $6k floor per sales ask, we prefer split structure: $4k upfront credit + $2k contingent rebate payable after the first invoice, subject to usage thresholds.

Please confirm which route you want to go so finance can log the promo and generate the accounting memo.

Marcus Lin
Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@brightwave.ai>, Jordan Hughes <j.hughes@brightwave.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Final — BrightWave 30d extension + $5k conversion credit (next steps)

Hi Sasha / Jordan — thanks for the patience. Quick recap and final offer we can commit to today:

Offer:
- 30-day trial extension effective immediately.
- One-time usage credit of $5,000 applied as account-level promo credit.
- Condition: Sign 12-month contract by 2026-07-10 or provide a PO with equivalent commitment.
- Alternate split (if you need $6k): we can do $4k upfront + $2k contingent rebate; let us know preference.

Attachments: brightwave_credit_terms_v1.pdf (terms), signed_mop_template.docx (signature-ready). Please review, sign the MOP, and return to me and Laura. Once signed, we will apply the credit and extend the eval window.

Next steps:
1) Confirm which credit structure you prefer (single $5k or split $4k/$2k).
2) Sign and return the MOP by 2026-07-10 to trigger credit.
3) I will schedule a 30-min kickoff to walk through the ingestion checklist once credit is live.

Happy to hop on a quick call if any of this needs clarification — we want to make this frictionless.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri ya@redwood.ai
Attachments: brightwave_credit_terms_v1.pdf, signed_mop_template.docx
